subject: Clarifying invoicing & PO reconciliation steps for Acme Printing onboarding
messages:
From: Laura Hayes <laura.hayes@acme-printing.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@acme-printing.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial invoice submission + sample (onboarding)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for walking us through the onboarding call last week. We're starting to prepare our first invoice for April services and wanted to confirm the format Redwood prefers. Attached is a sample invoice (PDF). A few quick questions:

- Should we include a Redwood PO number on the invoice header or in the line item notes?
- Do you require a separate remittance address vs. the billing address?
- Are consolidated monthly invoices okay for multiple smaller projects, or do you prefer per-PO invoices?

Also attaching our vendor onboarding form (banking + tax info). We can fill whatever template you prefer if you have one.

Appreciate the guidance — want to avoid rework when we submit formally.

Best,
Laura Hayes
AP Manager | Acme Printing Co.
accounts-payable@acme-printing.com

Attachment stubs: acme_sample_invoice_202704.pdf (invoice PDF), vendor_onboarding_form_filled.docx (placeholder)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Hayes <laura.hayes@acme-printing.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial invoice submission + sample (onboarding)

Laura — thanks for sending this over and for filling out the onboarding form early. High level answers below; Ben and Marissa are copied to confirm operational details and sync on PO mapping.

Short answers:
- Put the Redwood PO on the invoice header (if you have multiple PO lines, include PO on each line). That helps our AP system auto-match.
- Use the remittance address shown on our vendor onboarding portal; we can accept the billing address on the PDF for human review but remittance should match the portal if you plan to do ACH/wire.
- Consolidated monthly invoices are acceptable if they clearly reference the PO(s) they cover and provide line-item granularity. For small ad-hoc jobs, a single consolidated invoice with PO mapping is preferred to reduce transaction volume.

Can you attach one CSV/Excel example of how you'd present multiple PO lines (PO#, invoice line description, qty, unit price, tax, line total)? Ben — could you confirm any required field codes (e.g., our internal account code) and whether we need the vendor tax ID on every line?

I'll loop a short onboarding checklist (Doc) that you can use to avoid rejects.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial invoice submission + sample (onboarding)

Laura — thanks for the sample. Quick operational notes from Finance before you submit formally:

1) Required fields for our AP engine to auto-match (please include these exactly):
   - Redwood PO (PO-#####) in header and a PO# column in CSV if consolidating
   - Invoice number (unique)
   - Invoice date and due date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)
   - Line-level PO association (PO#, line # where applicable)
   - Line description and subtotal per line
   - Tax amount as separate column (if applicable)

2) Vendor-level items:
   - Vendor legal name and tax ID (we only require tax ID at vendor header level — not per line)
   - Bank details on onboarding form (encrypted upload via portal preferred)

3) PO reconciliation:
   - If an invoice covers multiple POs, please include a reconciliation table on the last page listing PO#, amount applied, and remaining PO balance. That helps prevent manual queries.

4) Preferred submission channel:
   - Portal upload (preferred): quicker ACK, structured fields, and better tracking.
   - Email fallback: invoice@redwood-invoice.com — if using email, put "PO:[list]" in the subject line so our parser tags it correctly.

We can accept consolidated monthly invoices, but please include the CSV mapping and the reconciliation table. If you want, Marissa can run a 15-min test with you next week to upload a sample invoice to the portal.

Ben Carter
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redwood_required_fields_template.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Hayes <laura.hayes@acme-printing.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial invoice submission + sample (onboarding)

Hi Laura — looping back after Ben's notes. Confirming next steps so we can get you a vendor code and set portal access: 

1) Please upload the vendor onboarding form to our secure intake (link below) and attach a redacted sample invoice (PDF) and a CSV mapping file that follows Ben's template. Once uploaded we'll generate a vendor code (VND-####) within 48 hours.

2) For the portal test: Marissa will schedule a 15-minute screenshare on Tue 5/25 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through uploading a consolidated invoice with 3 PO lines. Confirm if that works or propose an alternate time.

3) If you prefer email submission for the first two invoices, send to invoice@redwood-invoice.com with subject: "PO: PO-12345,PO-12346 — Acme April Consolidated" and attach the CSV; we'll manually triage until portal access is ready.

Link to secure intake: https://secure.redwood.com/vendor-intake (upload token will be emailed after initial onboarding step)

Small note: For multi-entity POs showing different legal entities, include billing entity on the invoice header. That avoids cross-entity payment delays.

Thanks — we look forward to getting you live.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Success | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0134
